coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

notes.accuracy_caveat: PARTIALLY REAL -- the outer boundary is a real polygonized city block from real street geometry, not hand-traced; only the internal A/B split line is approximate (a bisection, since no real street divides this block into A and B).
notes.digitized_from: Real block boundary from real street geometry (src/block_fit.py load_blocks(), polygonized from data/raw/official_street_centerlines.geojson); the plan's own A/B internal split has no mapped street, so it's a straight bisection along the block's long axis, not a real line.

changes.text: The geometry notes said this block continues the 15A/15B parking lot and that no project had been found. Imagery (USDA NAIP, viewed 2026-09-29) shows open graded ground rather than parked cars, UCSF's June 2025 deck lists the block as undeveloped research land, and the notes now reference this record's own May 2026 Regents milestones, whose UCSF source could not be read and whose block location is unconfirmed. The Dec 2015 map claim in the 2019 milestone is now cited to the Long-Range Property Management Plan.

record.notes: No building on this site as of UCSF's June 2025 CAC deck ('Undeveloped parcels remaining'; 'Block 16A & B - Research'); in USDA NAIP imagery (viewed 2026-09-29) the block reads as open graded ground with no visible parked cars, an imagery observation no cited document states. The OCII plan's Dec 2019 Land Use Map designates this block for UCSF (no use type given). This record's milestones list a May 2026 UC Regents approval of the UCSF Bakar Ear & Hearing Institute at Fifth Street and Nelson Rising Lane, citing a UCSF News page that could not be read on 2026-09-29; whether that project is on this block is not confirmed by a readable source.
